hero.title: Causes for the Decline of Buddhism
hero.description: A comprehensive analysis of the internal and external factors that led to the gradual fading of Buddhism from its birthplace.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Gangetic Heartland loss
  • Shift to SE Asia
  • Central Asian decline

Personalities

  • Shankaracharya (Revivalist)
  • Kumārila Bhaṭṭa
  • Bakhtiyar Khilji
  • Internal Degeneration
    • Monastic Corruption: Wealth accumulation in Sanghas
    • Split in Sangha: Hinayana vs Mahayana
    • Introduction of Idolatry (Mahayana)
  • External Challenges
    • Revival of Brahmanism: Puranic Hinduism, Bhakti Movement
    • Loss of Royal Patronage: Gupta and later rulers favored Vaishnavism
    • Language Barrier: Shift from Pali/Prakrit to Sanskrit
FactorNature of Impact
IdeologicalVedantic synthesis by Shankaracharya
AdministrativeLoss of patronage in post-Gupta era
PhysicalTurko-Afghan invasions

timeline.title: The Chronological Framework
timeline.description: Critical junctures in the rise and eventual dissolution of Buddhist prominence in Ancient India.

cards.details: Rise of Buddhism; patronized by Magadhan rulers like Bimbisara and Ajatashatru.
Ashoka's Kalinga War and propagation of Dhamma turning Buddhism into a world religion.
Destruction of Nalanda and Vikramshila by Bakhtiyar Khilji, marking the end of organized Buddhist monastic life in North India.

mnemonics.title: Mnemonics to Remember
mnemonics.description: Acronyms to remember the primary factors of decline.

items.title: R.I.S.E.N
items.decryption: Royal patronage shift (R), Internal corruption (I), Sanskrit over Pali (S), External invasions (E), Neglect by masses (N).

items: Common misconception that Buddhism vanished instantly; it was a process of assimilation.
Assuming the decline was only due to Muslim invasions; socio-religious changes within Hinduism were equally critical.
Thinking Buddhism died in India completely; it survived in pockets of the Himalayas and Bengal until the 12th century.
